readme.title: Formalizing the Stacks Project in Lean
readme.excerpt: We are formalizing the [Stacks Project](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/) in Lean 4, building on Mathlib, and organizing the resulting mathematical definitions, statements, and proofs into **ReasLib**, a shared and reusable library. The Stacks Project is a comprehensive open-source reference that systematically organizes knowledge in algebraic geometry. We have completed an initial large-scale formalization of its mathematical statements in Lean 4 and integrated the results into ReasLib.
